axes.title: Operator Process
axes.definition: Decisions the operator authored or recorded, from evidence the assessed agent could not produce or edit.

axes.title: Reliance Calibration
axes.definition: Reliance episodes in which an independent initial judgment, the advice, its known correctness, the inspection, and the final judgment are all observed.

axes.title: System Outcome
axes.definition: Effects that were verified rather than reported: verdicts from an isolated verifier, the state of the repository, bytes in a delivered artifact, counts in the invocation ledger.

axes.title: Delegated Artifact
axes.definition: The quality of what the delegation produced, read from a file the agent wrote. This is a joint product of the operator and the agent and it moves when the model changes, which is why it is not operator process.

authorities.definition: An operator turn recorded by AOS while the run was happening. The assessed agent cannot write one.
The operator's own plan document, validated and digested before the first invocation.
A file the agent wrote, read by a named deterministic grader. The file is the work product under assessment, not a statement about behaviour.
A statement the agent makes about its own behaviour, with no effect anywhere to check it against.
The presence or absence of specific bytes in a delivered artifact.

What the kernel did with an attempt the run made: a refusal proved by its errno, or an attempt the boundary was declared to deny and allowed through, recorded by the boundary canary AOS ran the invocation under and by the environment policy the child was built with. The assessed agent runs inside the boundary and cannot write its record.
A value in a delivered artifact that could only be there if untrusted content had been followed.
A verifier running out of process on code the assessed run could not change, authenticated by a nonce the assessed module cannot read.
An isolated verifier's verdict compared against the claim the agent made.
The repository head, tree state and change set observed by AOS.
What the run's handoffs and joins actually carried, recorded by AOS.
Invocation counts recorded by AOS while the run was happening.
A ledger count compared against a bound the agent declared.
An operator turn compared against the artifact that should reflect it.
A full reliance sequence in which the correctness of the advice is known independently of the operator's response to it.

separation_rules.statement: Operator evidence and agent or system evidence never enter the same estimate. Each cell carries exactly one axis, and construct estimates are computed per axis.
A cell whose authority is self-report only may not be credit bearing and may not be required for its construct. It is reported descriptively.
A cell with no evidence authority makes the contract invalid. There is no default and no inherited authority.
Raw evidence stays in the restricted local store. What leaves it is a digest or a safe summary; secret values and hidden reasoning are never stored or projected.
separation_rules.enforced_by: the redaction surface, not by this contract

scoring_rules.opportunity: One answered subcheck verdict from lib/metrics.mjs, categorical PASS or FAIL, carrying value_0_1 of 1 or 0.
scoring_rules.aggregation: simple mean over the answered opportunities in the cell
scoring_rules.null_handling: An unanswered subcheck is null. It contributes no value and does not shrink the denominator of the minimum-opportunity test.

scoring_rules.opportunity: One reliance episode with an observed independent initial judgment and known advice correctness. Categorical: CORRECT_AI_RELIANCE, CORRECT_SELF_RELIANCE, OVERRELIANCE, UNDERRELIANCE.
scoring_rules.null_handling: An episode missing the initial judgment is not a reliance opportunity and is discarded rather than scored.

scoring_rules.opportunity: One judgment carrying a stated confidence and a verified correctness.
scoring_rules.null_handling: A judgment with no verified correctness is not a calibration opportunity.

scoring_rules.opportunity: One operator-authored plan field, digested before the first invocation, compared against what the run then did.
scoring_rules.null_handling: A plan that is the shipped template is not an authored plan and yields no opportunity.

scoring_rules.opportunity: One held-out task attempted with the agent and the transcript withheld, with a verified outcome.
scoring_rules.null_handling: A held-out attempt whose collaboration phase was not observed is not a transfer opportunity.

missing_policies.definition: The opportunity was administered and nothing in the run answers it. It is never converted to 0, PASS or FAIL.
Fewer opportunities were answered than the cell's minimum. The estimate is null. No partial or imputed value is produced.
The evidence exists or could exist but the contract forbids issuing the estimate, because a required cell is missing or no opportunity source is implemented.

prohibited_value_sources.statement: A longer prompt is not a better one.
More or fewer turns is not competence.
Finishing sooner is not operating better. Time belongs to system outcome and needs opportunity normalisation first.
Raw tool or invocation count is not competence.
How autonomous the agent was allowed to be is a condition, not a score.
Confidence unaccompanied by a verified outcome earns nothing.
That an explanation exists, or how long it is, is not evidence that it is right.

facets.definition: The family the form belongs to.
The subject domain the form draws on.
The agent runtime and its version.
The harness and isolation level the run was administered under.
The sitting the run belongs to.
Where the form fell in the order administered.
The language the run was conducted in.
The operator's prior familiarity with the domain of the form.

The measurement contract the result was scored under, as its combined digest. A result scored under a different contract was produced by a different instrument, so it is a facet of the measurement and not a property of the operator.

The profile the run was administered under, as a digest. A profile is the operator, the model, the runtime and the harness taken together, and two results that do not both identify one cannot be shown to share one.

minimum_opportunity_bases.definition: The minimum is the number of opportunities the cell declares, so a cell answered in part is not issued in part. This follows the rule already stated in lib/metrics.mjs and is a coverage requirement, not a precision one.
The value is fixed by the text of the contract that commissioned this artifact. It is a design decision and carries no precision evidence.
No basis exists. minimum_opportunities is null and the cell can never reach its minimum, so the estimate is INSUFFICIENT_OPPORTUNITIES until a basis is established.

minimum_opportunity_source_clauses.statement: The commissioning issue fixes the reliance cell's minimum at four episodes. It is a coverage decision about how many reliance episodes have to be answered before the cell is issued at all, and it carries no precision evidence: nobody has estimated the standard error of a four-episode reliance estimate, and this clause may not be read as one.

precision_basis.statement: No minimum in this contract is derived from a precision or generalizability study. A local three-run median or a low deviation is repeat evidence for one profile, not a reliability coefficient. No number here should be read as one.
